X01.title: GitHub repository access
X01.need: Connected GitHub with authorized target organization/repository and required write/PR/check scopes. Never assume private account entitlement or bypass branch rules.

X02.title: Canonical End-To-End-Everywhere standard
X02.need: Actual controlled document/repository revision and reusable security engine contract. A proposed crosswalk is not canonical conformance.

X03.title: Engine Room integration
X03.need: Actual endpoint/schema, authentication, project identity and permitted mutation contract. Proposed intermediate JSON remains unsynchronized.

X04.title: Render authorization
X04.need: Authorized workspace/service identities, deployment rights, DNS ownership and budget. Do not provision new paid resources without authority.

X05.title: Neon authorization
X05.need: Project-specific authorized resource IDs, roles, connection scopes, extension capability and recovery policy. No unrelated project database reuse.

X06.title: Storage, identity, key and notification providers
X06.need: Existing reusable engines or authorized providers, actual contracts, credentials by secret name, costs and privacy terms.

X07.title: Expert and community review
X07.need: Qualified historical, source-language, rights, fiscal, legal, accessibility, safeguarding and independent security reviewers for relevant release gates.

X08.title: Incremental costs
X08.need: Explicit authority for new hosting/storage capacity, email, AI, licensed images, payment processing and external assessments. Existing resources must be verified first.

X09.title: Full research artifacts and item rights
X09.need: All four components and six current documents must be revalidated at import; only CORE byte/schema checks were performed in preparing this plan. Item rights and research review remain open.

X10.title: AI provider/data-processing authority
X10.need: Approved provider/model contract, retention/data handling, budgets, evaluation and permission-first retrieval. Disabled until satisfied.

X11.title: Payments and civic provider authority
X11.need: Authorized payee/legal organization, provider agreement, verified compliance disclosures and actual district/contact data for enabled services.

X12.title: Governmental authority
X12.need: Actual enacted law, implementing rules, authorized operator, dedicated funding/credentials and independent acceptance. No current enactment or authority is asserted.
